integrity: The full theorem is supported by the supplied infinite symbolic proof. The accompanying finite checker is corroboration only. No claim of external or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies additive-cube orders fully only for base four; it excludes odd orders for every even base but does not assert occurrence of all even orders for bases at least six. No result for odd alphabets or higher additive powers. Unindexed prior statements remain possible.
title: Odd-order exclusion and the complete additive-cube order spectrum in base four
